text:
Ivy: Quick usability note from 4 sessions: users click the quickstart strip and expect to see an example output inline before committing. Noah: Agreed. The strip is unobtrusive but leaves value implicit. Propose a collapsed preview (1-line summary) that expands to show a 2-line sample + Run button. Sam: Metrics: experiments that included previews saw a ~10% lift in completion. We should A/B copy too: "Run sample project" vs "Preview sample" vs "Try demo". Tariq: Accessibility: if preview expands, announce via aria-live and mark region with role="region" and aria-label="Sample preview". Ensure Run button is keyboard-focusable and contrast for preview chips >= 4.5:1. A11yBot: Quick SR snippet: ```
Sample output: "Hello, Redwood!"
``` Ivy: Decision: ship collapsed preview in strip by default + a "Full setup" modal link. Telemetry events: onboard_strip_click, preview_expand, run_sample_click, strip_dismiss. Dismiss hides strip for 14 days. Sam: Eng estimate ~3 dev days for preview card + SR notes + telemetry. I'll file the ticket with mock and a11y checklist. Noah: I'll run copy A/B with "Run sample project" (explicit) vs "Preview sample". Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
